blocks.text: Beach holiday in Angra dos Reis

blocks.text:
Several days are set aside entirely for relaxation at an all-inclusive hotel.

You can spend time on the beach, swim, relax by the pool or choose additional activities at sea: boat trips between the islands, snorkelling and diving with an instructor.

The coast of Angra dos Reis is dotted with islands and bays. Many beaches are easier to reach from the water, so a boat trip is a natural way to explore this part of the itinerary. From the boat, you can see forested slopes, small beaches and sheltered stretches of the bay. Stops allow time for swimming or snorkelling.

Angra dos Reis is known for its many islands and sheltered bays. The water offers particularly good views of the wooded slopes and small beaches best reached by boat.

This part of the programme deliberately leaves plenty of free time. After Carnival and busy days in Rio, you can plan each day yourself: go to the sea in the morning, choose a boat trip or stay by the pool in the afternoon, and dine at the hotel or a small waterfront restaurant in the evening.

The beach stay makes up more than half the trip. After 4 nights in Rio, you have 7 nights on the coast. This makes the trip suitable for those who want to experience Carnival without spending their whole holiday rushing from one excursion to the next.

One evening, you could try the local cuisine and order fish or seafood. On other days, you need not plan anything in advance: the all-inclusive arrangement lets you stay at the hotel, while the flexible schedule allows you to change plans according to the weather and whether you feel like visiting the islands.
